column4: cleat#2880 (CREATE/DROP INDEX, slices 1+2): auditlog's and blobstore's slice-1 tests of this name (see below), plus slice 2's notifications, oauthprovider, scheduledbackup and webhookingest -- each package's own v1 CREATE INDEX guard(s), all sharing this exact function name. check-skip-budget.sh's regex is unanchored to package, so one line with count=6 covers all six rather than six lines with the same regex colliding. Slice 1 alone: auditlog's three CREATE INDEX guards on audit_events, and blobstore's two on blob_index.

cleat#2880 (CREATE/DROP INDEX, slices 1+2): eventstore's slice-1 test of this name (v1's idx_event_stream_lookup CREATE INDEX guard) plus slice 2's scheduler (v1's idx_schedules_tenant_enabled_next CREATE INDEX guard) -- same collision reason as the line above.

cleat#2880 (CREATE/DROP INDEX slice 1): eventtriggers' new idempotency regression test for v1's two CREATE INDEX guards (idx_event_subscriptions_type, idx_ingested_events_unprocessed) and v3's one (idx_event_awaiters_type).
